subject.title: fix(qqbot): surface terminal reply-session conflict failures

question: Should QQBot wait for or fold in the shared Plugin SDK conflict classifier from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109902, or may this urgent terminal-notice fix land temporarily with its extension-local regex?
rationale: The terminal behavior is proven and useful, but repository policy discourages adding another copied classifier; automation cannot decide whether urgency warrants a temporary owner-boundary exception or whether the shared API must land first.

options.title: Land shared classifier first
options.body: Approve and land the shared Plugin SDK classifier, then rebase this PR to import it before merging the QQBot terminal-notice behavior.

options.title: Accept a temporary local classifier
options.body: Merge this proven QQBot fix now while explicitly requiring the open shared-classifier work to migrate QQBot and remove the local regex promptly.

recommendation.title: Land shared classifier first
recommendation.body: Approve and land the shared Plugin SDK classifier, then rebase this PR to import it before merging the QQBot terminal-notice behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged QQBot outbound work makes openperf the best available channel-side owner to coordinate the urgency and Plugin SDK sequencing choice.
